sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Water Release, Wind Release, Efficient

system.description:
You conjure Water into the shape of any simple weapon of your choice. At the beginning of each of your turns, choose the form of the weapon. The construct weapon has the same statistics of the original weapon, but deals cold damage. When you take the Attack action with it you can use your ninjutsu or taijutsu attack bonus in place of your weapon attack bonus, and use your highest jutsu modifier, in place of your Strength modifier.

This weapon can be used as a component for Bukijutsu you cast.

If you take the Attack action with this weapon while occupying a Ice Mirrors, increase the number of attacks made by +1.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher and you take the Attack action with this weapon and you do not have the Extra Attack feature, you can Attack twice, instead of once.
